title: Quantitative stochastic homogenization for long-range random walks with critical jump index
summary: In this paper, we study the stochastic homogenization for a class of symmetric random walks in random conductance model, whose one-step transition probability from $x$ to $y$ is proportional to $|x-y|^{-d-2}$. As the associated jumping kernel fails to be $L^2$-integrable yet admits a finite $α$-th moment for all $α\in (0,2)$, we refer to the corresponding process $(X^\w_t)_{t\ge0}$ as a long-range random walk with critical jump index.
